content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the klaipeda district court the court made a final decision regarding the division of matrimonial property in a divorce case the defendant was awarded a pleasure boat and its engine as their personal property while the applicant received monetary compensation the court also ordered the defendant to pay monthly maintenance payments for their minor child both parties presented their arguments regarding the breakdown of the marriage and the court upheld the applicants claim for maintenance and divided the property accordingly the court also addressed the allocation of creditors liabilities and awarded costs to the claimant the applicant was granted stateguaranteed legal aid and exempted from paying stamp duty while the defendant was ordered to pay the stamp duty and maintenance costs the court dissolved the marriage and dismissed the remaining part of the action related to the payment of maintenance periodic instalments
